datasets.title: UCI-45 Cleveland / DA-A2
datasets.intended_role: Existing five-field historical D-047 internal development baseline; candidate for a future separately approved frozen model that could be assessed externally. Never its own external test.
known_facts: 303 headline instances; class vector 164/55/36/35/13; under 0 vs 1-4 binarization: 139 positive / 164 negative (E4 arithmetic from E1).
Official sources define age, sex, cp, trestbps and restecg; trestbps is resting blood pressure on admission in mm Hg; num wording is 0 <50% and 1 >50%.

Historical internal exploratory D-047 result (INTERNAL_EXPLORATORY_NOT_SUPERVISOR_APPROVED), not re-executed: source-reported repeated nested-CV AUROC 0.8271 +/- 0.0097 over four dependent repeats; outcome-proportion adequacy targets 382 and MAPE criterion 459 unmet at n=303.

Official UCI-45 owner page and heart-disease.names (E1) explicitly list chol (serum cholesterol, mg/dL) and fbs (binary fasting blood sugar >120 mg/dL) among the standard 13 predictors/14 fields of the underlying 13-predictor source; both are omitted from CardioAssist's frozen D-047 five-field resting panel and are UNASSESSED_DIFFERENT_ESTIMAND for any study (report section 6.2.1); neither marker is authorized or investigated here.
uncertainties: No dated per-field evidence that all five proposed inputs existed before the reference procedure (six-week window exists only in an E3 transcription, not per-field clocks).
No primary ruling on exact-50 records or equivalence with UCI-412 >=50%.
Cross-site patient overlap cannot be excluded from dummy-identifier public metadata; raw-to-processed identity unverified.
leakage_risks: ca, thal, exang, oldpeak and slope are outcome-adjacent or procedure-adjacent; prohibited as pre-test predictors.
Row order and identifiers are never predictors.
Applying the 1989 historical accuracy figure to the five-field panel would conflate different models and feature sets.

recommendation.rationale: Owner definitions are explicit and reviewable (GO_FOR_REVIEW_ONLY for Q-01/Q-02 source clarification), but timing and threshold equivalence remain unresolved and no frozen full-cohort artifact or approved development protocol exists; any new development/freeze role is HOLD_WITH_SPECIFIC_MISSING_EVIDENCE and serving/validity claims remain rejected.

ai_9_2_blockers.summary: Real same-source Clinical vs Clinical+Labs paired incremental-value study on UCI-412; currently inadmissible on feature, timing, source, protocol and authorization grounds.

feature.blocker: The 17 laboratory/echo field names exist only as an original-author published table (2013 RCM Table 2); 17/17 token-level correspondence is not a certified workbook header audit.

No printed lab/echo units in the original-author 2013 RCM Table 2 itself, except EF(%). The 2015 inventor patent application does print some laboratory/echo units (and BP mmHg, PR ppm), but it is a 335-person/50-feature distinct embodiment - NOT verification of UCI-412's delivered 303-row XLSX units, lab timing or clinical correctness; units must not be transferred between those sources without evidence. Secondary/frozen ranges disagree in places (TG paper 37-1050 vs dict 50-400; PLT 25-742 vs 100-450; K 3.0-6.6 vs 3.0-6.0; WBC 3700-18000 vs 2000-15000; ESR 1-90 vs 0-60). Frozen secondary units (mg/dL, mm/hr, ...) must not be treated as original-author units.
Cr/CR glossed 'C, Creatine' in the paper footnote - not verified as serum creatinine; no assay method, unit, specimen or timing.

EF(%) is echocardiographic; Region with RWMA has a blank range and frozen 0-3 coding conflicts with the paper mean 0.620 +/- 1.133; VHD is ordinal Normal/Mild/Moderate/Severe with known/predominant valvular disease excluded - selection, not a free predictor; never routine 'labs'.
No owner confirmation of missing-value sentinels/codes in labs (raw -9.0 vs processed '?'); lab-specific per-field missingness unknown; abstention vs impute undefinable.
Six clinical binary predictors remain S-9 provisional (DM, HTN, Current Smoker, EX-Smoker, FH, Typical Chest Pain); a labs-augmented model inherits this unresolved encoding.
feature.evidence: AGENTS.md M3a Amendment A-1; register Q-06; RH02_UCI412 investigation

feature.blocker: 0/16 owner-verified pre-angiography clinical timestamps; labs have no per-field clocks at all; 2013 RCM frames labs/echo as inputs to a per-artery study with same-admission workup compatible - timing is unprovable from current public evidence.
Estimand feasibility at n=303 (216 Cad/87 Normal) vs already-unmet basic-panel target 315; no adequacy estimate for the paired delta-AUROC/delta-Brier estimand; R^2 criteria NOT ASSESSED.

timing.blocker: No per-field timestamps for any of the 16 clinical or 17 lab/echo fields exist in any owner or author material reviewed.

2013 RCM explicitly positions labs/echo as the inputs of a per-artery (LAD/LCX/RCA) prediction study; same-admission measurement is fully compatible with the text - no pre-angiography or pre-knowledge-of-outcome clock is stated for any lab.

UCI-45's underlying 13-predictor schema documents chol and fbs at all four sites (with major missingness/source-specific quality concerns, e.g. Switzerland chol=0 in all 123 rows), but the frozen D-047 five-field panel omits them, they are not verified pre-angiography, and they are UNASSESSED_DIFFERENT_ESTIMAND - not a Clinical+Labs pairing (see alternative_same_source_matrix). The only currently investigated same-person pairing is UCI-412's 17-name laboratory/echo extension, whose timing fails T-1/T-2.
timing.evidence: RH02_ISSUE107_PUBLIC_SOURCE_DATASET_AUDIT_2026_11_19.md sections 4.1-4.6; UCI-45 owner page / heart-disease.names (E1); report section 6.2.1

timing.blocker: Patent angiography-need design intent (algorithm for determining need for angiography) is modelling intent, not an acquisition log; the abandoned 335-patient/50-feature embodiment does not bind the delivered UCI-412 rows.

source.blocker: UCI-412 is the only currently investigated and registered same-source clinical+labs pairing - specifically its 17-name laboratory/echo extension - and is under SCIENTIFIC_HOLD for new real fitting; #106 forbids new real UCI-412 training / AI-9.2 pending owner CRF/codebook. The UCI-45 family (Cleveland/Hungary/VA/Switzerland) DOES document two biochemical markers in the underlying 13-predictor schema (chol serum cholesterol mg/dL; fbs binary fasting blood sugar >120 mg/dL), omitted from the frozen D-047 five-field resting panel; this is a different, unassessed estimand (see alternative_same_source_matrix), not a pairing, and carries no timing, validity or admissibility evidence. Statlog has none. AngioCAD's schema is unopened and not admitted.
source.evidence: RH02_UCI412_ANGIOCAD_SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE_INVESTIGATION_2026_11_19.md sections 9-10 (D-UCI-TIME); UCI-45 owner page / heart-disease.names (E1); report section 6.2.1

source.blocker: Row identity across 2012 JMSS, 2013 RCM, 2013 CMPB, the 2015 patent (335/50) and the UCI/Mendeley workbooks is not proven; 37 + 17 = 54 is an explicit hypothesis, not adopted; no labs row-join can rest on it.
UCI-411 adds outcome-derived artery fields to the same 303 - not independent, no labs for AI-9.2, zero added people.

2013 CMPB Table 1 (lab names/units/ranges) and 2016/2017 original tables are unread (paywalled); absence in accessible materials does not prove non-existence, but until read/obtained the study is blocked.

No sub-cohort with VERIFIED pre-outcome labs + a target-compatible label exists inside the portfolio: UCI-412's labs fail section 6.1, and UCI-45's documented chol/fbs are not verified pre-angiography markers, are omitted from the frozen D-047 five-field panel, and are UNASSESSED_DIFFERENT_ESTIMAND (see alternative_same_source_matrix). No other reputable source may be substituted without a fresh, separately reviewed suitability pass (not performed here, per scope).
